files.s: Tarski proved that if an operation satisfies `x = y ◇ (z ◇ (x ◇ (y ◇ z)))`, then there is a natural abelian group structure given by ``` 0 := x ◇ x (for any, or all, x) -x := 0 ◇ x x + y := x ◇ (0 ◇ y) ``` so that `◇` is the "minus" operation in the group. In particular, the resulting `+` operation is cancelative, commutative, and associative.
